params.name: Input
params.description: Node whose geometry is passed through unchanged when Index is 0.

params.name: Input 2
params.description: Node whose geometry is passed through unchanged when Index is 1.

params.name: Input 3
params.description: Node whose geometry is passed through unchanged when Index is 2.

params.name: Input 4
params.description: Node whose geometry is passed through unchanged when Index is 3.

params.name: Index
params.description: Which input to pass on: 0 is Input, 1 is Input 2, and so on. Values past the range are clamped; an empty slot passes nothing.
